source.a: Two divisions — Meiosis I and II.
source.exp: Meiosis occurs in germ cells through two divisions, halves chromosome number from 2n to n and produces four haploid genetically different cells. It supports gamete formation and genetic variation.

source.exp: Low secretion of growth hormone in childhood causes stunted growth, classically termed pituitary dwarfism; excess GH causes gigantism in children and acromegaly in adults.

source.exp: The adrenal medulla secretes the catecholamines epinephrine and norepinephrine, which participate in the fight-or-flight response.

source.q: Underproduction of hormones from the adrenal cortex can cause which disease?
source.exp: NCERT associates underproduction of adrenal-cortex hormones with Addison’s disease, characterised by weakness and disturbances of metabolism and electrolyte balance.

source.exp: Addison’s disease is associated with underproduction of hormones from the adrenal cortex. This is different from adrenaline/noradrenaline secretion by the adrenal medulla.

source.exp: Ball-and-socket joints permit movement in several planes plus rotation. The shoulder and hip are the standard examples.

edits.after: (very similar genetically; mutations may introduce variation)

source.exp: Typical tomato flowers contain both functional stamens and carpels and are bisexual.

edits.after: Papaya and date palm

source.exp: The vas deferens and duct of the seminal vesicle unite to form an ejaculatory duct, which opens into the urethra.

source.exp: Rhizopus produces numerous asexual sporangiospores inside a sporangium. Spores aid rapid multiplication and dispersal.

source.a: They can disperse widely and many can survive adverse conditions.
